settings.heading: Read the approved manual
settings.text: Review every product-specific instruction, warning and verified limit before use.

settings.heading: Inflate as directed
settings.text: Use only the specified pressure and inflation method. Check chambers, valves, seams and attachments.

settings.heading: Attach and check
settings.text: Fit only approved components with power switched off, then complete the manual's pre-use checks.

settings.heading: Enter, steer and relax
settings.text: Use with another responsible adult in a calm, controlled pool and stay clear of swimmers and pool hazards.

settings.heading: Switch off, dry and store
settings.text: Follow the manual for exiting, disconnection, charging, cleaning, inspection, drying and storage.
